usage.source_scope: Source-mask-conditioned, geometry-enhanced cross-view segmentation with point-guided prediction and iterative mask refinement.
usage.project_application: After a z-buffer-visible reference door face is established, compare VGGT-Segmentor with the existing fixed cross-view transfer on identical source masks, query frames, candidates, and evaluator mappings.
usage.modifications: Keep exact-instance authority outside the model and retain explicit NONE/UNKNOWN. The challenger may transfer only an already authorized source mask and may not create a door identity from appearance similarity.
usage.expected_effect: Improve exact-door Top-1, median IoU, centroid-inside, and world-centroid error without more wrong-door commits. Close the challenger if it fails this joint comparison; no prompt or threshold rescue.

evaluation.setup: Candidate challenger after reference-side visibility is independently qualified.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Cross-view mask transfer does not establish public physical identity, functional entrance status, reachability, arrival, handoff, user benefit, product readiness, or safety.

evidence.summary: Primary preprint reviewed for source-mask-conditioned geometry-enhanced cross-view segmentation and its Ego-Exo4D evidence boundary.

history.change: Added as a direct cross-view transfer challenger conditional on independently authorized reference visibility; no current route decision changed.
